messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

Your order Shop···· is paid and hasn't shipped yet. It's a Magic M. 40T, and I'm sorry it's taken this long. We gave dates on this miner that we didn't keep.

All the 40T units are now built. Magic M. expects them to ship out from the factory on November 12. The warehouse is holding your order for the unit, and we'll email you tracking as soon as your miner ships to you.

You can follow the shipment on its way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
